description: Defines the 'Connect' class used for establishing a new streaming connection via StreamingActor, including connection parameters and session details.

classes.name: Connect
classes.description: Represents a message to establish a streaming connection, encapsulating connection details, session expiration, and acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: getEventAndResponsePublisher
methods.description: Returns the source queue for events and responses.

methods.name: getConnectionCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID of the connection.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the streaming connection.

methods.name: getSessionExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the session expiration time, if set.

methods.name: getJsonSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema version of the request.

methods.name: getDeclaredAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledgement labels that this session may send.
